data.gender_notes: Lenity is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lenity is derived from the Greek word leon, meaning 'lion'. The name Lenity suggests a strong, peaceful woman who embodies serene calmness and gentleness. In Christian tradition, Lenity may be seen as a reflection of the peaceful nature of God. The name Lenity carries the meaning “Serene calmness, gentleness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lenity usually hope their child will grow to embody serene calmness, gentleness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
